name: Prompt for an explicit safety factor target
logic: If no safety_factor_target is set for a load-bearing task, require the user to select or justify one before a green report state is shown.
source_notes: General engineering practice. Not a substitute for a specific standard.

name: Warn when FDM printed parts carry structural load
logic: If manufacturing_method_id is fdm-3d-printing and the part is load-bearing, add print orientation and layer adhesion warnings.
source_notes: Seed heuristic. Require material datasheet or test coupons for engineering claims.

name: Require manufacturer bend-radius data for moving cables
logic: If a cable crosses a moving joint and no manufacturer bend radius is recorded, mark the rating as needs review.
source_notes: Do not invent cable flex ratings. Link or attach supplier datasheets in project data.

name: Do not redistribute protected standards text
logic: Catalogs may store standard identifiers, links, and user-provided pack references, but must not copy protected standards text unless redistribution rights are documented.
source_notes: Repository policy. Legal review required before shipping authoritative standards packs.
